3-1 INTRODUCTION  3-1 引言

  • Experimental evidence that radiation is particle-like in its interaction with matter, as distinguished from the wavelike nature of radiation when it propagates: e.g. Photoelectric effect and Compton scattering.
    实验证据表明辐射在与物质相互作用时呈现粒子特性，这与辐射传播时的波动特性有所区别：例如光电效应和康普顿散射。
  • A generalization of this result, due to de Broglie, which leads directly into quantum mechanics.
    这个结果的一个推广，源于 de Broglie，直接引入了量子力学。

3-2 Photoelectric effect
3-2 光电效应

Aside from exhibiting wave-like properties, light can behave like a stream of “particles”. This is to view light as a stream of discrete entities or energy packets called photons, each carrying a quantum of energy h v h v hvh v,
除了表现出波动特性，光还可以像一束“粒子”一样行为。这是将光视为一串离散的实体或称为光子的能量包，每个光子携带一个量子能量 h v h v hvh v 。
and momentum, h / λ h / λ h//lambdah / \lambda.

3-3 Einstein's Quantum Theory of the Photoelectric Effect
3-3 爱因斯坦的光电效应量子理论

Photon is a bundle of energy initially localized in a small volume of space, and that it remains localized as it moves away from the source with velocity c c cc. The energy content E E EE of the photon, is related to its frequency v v vv by :
光子是一束最初局限于小空间体积的能量，并且在以速度 c c cc 从源头移动时仍然保持局限。光子的能量内容 E E EE 与其频率 v v vv 之间的关系为：
E = h v E = h v E=hvE=h v
In the photoelectric process one photon is completely absorbed by one electron in the photocathode. The electron emit from the surface of the metal with kinetic energy:

h v h v hvh v : energy of the absorbed incident photon Φ o Φ o Phi_(o)\Phi_{o} : work function.

3-4 DE BROGLIE'S POSTULATE: WAVELIKE PROPERTIES OF PARTICLES
3-4 德布罗意的假设：粒子的波动性特征

The hypothesis of de Broglie:
德布罗意的假设：

The dual, i.e. wave-particle, behavior of radiation applies equally well to matter. Just as a photon has a light wave associated with it that governs its motion, so a material particle (e.g. an electron) has an associated matter wave that governs its motion.
辐射的双重性，即波粒行为，同样适用于物质。正如光子有与之相关的光波来支配其运动，物质粒子（例如电子）也有与之相关的物质波来支配其运动。
He proposed that the wave aspects of matter are related to its particle aspects in exactly the same quantitative way that is the case for radiation.
他提出物质的波动特性与其粒子特性之间的关系，正如辐射的情况一样，以完全相同的定量方式相关。

Lecture 3 Elementary Quantum Mechanics
讲座 3 基础量子力学

According to de Broglie,  根据 de Broglie，
For matter and for radiation alike the total energy E E EE of an entity is related to the frequency vof the wave associated with its motion.
对于物质和辐射，实体的总能量 E E EE 与其运动所关联的波的频率 v 相关。
Momentum p p pp of the entity is related to the wavelength λ λ lambda\lambda of the associated wave.
实体的动量 p p pp 与相关波的波长 λ λ lambda\lambda 有关。
de Broglie relation: λ = h p  de Broglie relation:  λ = h p " de Broglie relation: "lambda=(h)/(p)\text { de Broglie relation: } \lambda=\frac{h}{p}

Lecture 3 Elementary Quantum Mechanics
讲座 3 基础量子力学

3-5 THE WAVE-PARTICLE DUALITY
3-5 波粒二象性

To understand radiation, we need to invoke a particle model in some situations, as in the photoelectric effect, and a wave model in other situations, as in the diffraction of x rays.
要理解辐射，我们需要在某些情况下引入粒子模型，例如在光电效应中，而在其他情况下则引入波动模型，例如在 X 射线的衍射中。
Wave-particle duality applies to matter as well as to radiation.
波粒二象性适用于物质和辐射。
The charge-to-mass ratio of the electron suggest a particle model, but electron diffraction suggests a wave model.
电子的电荷与质量比暗示了粒子模型，但电子衍射则暗示了波动模型。

3-6 SCHRÖDINGER THEORY OF QUANTUM MECHANICS
3-6 施罗丁格量子力学理论

The Schrödinger’s theory specifies:
薛定谔的理论规定：
the laws of wave motion that the particles of any microscopic system obey.
微观系统中粒子遵循的波动运动法则。
This is done by specifiying
这是通过指定来完成的
-for each system, the equation that controls the behavior of the wave function
-对于每个系统，控制波函数行为的方程
-the connection between the behavior of the wave function and the behavior of the particle.
-波函数的行为与粒子的行为之间的联系。

Steady-state form of the Schrödinger equation
薛定谔方程的稳态形式

− ℏ 2 2 m ∂ 2 Ψ ∂ x 2 + V Ψ = i ℏ ∂ Ψ ∂ t − ℏ 2 2 m ∂ 2 Ψ ∂ x 2 + V Ψ = i ℏ ∂ Ψ ∂ t -(ℏ^(2))/(2m)(del^(2)Psi)/(delx^(2))+V Psi=iℏ(del Psi)/(del t)-\frac{\hbar^{2}}{2 m} \frac{\partial^{2} \Psi}{\partial x^{2}}+V \Psi=i \hbar \frac{\partial \Psi}{\partial t}
In many physical situations, the energy of a particle may not vary with time, although it may vary with position. If this is the case Schrödinger eqn can be considerably simplified by removing all reference to the time t t tt.
在许多物理情况下，粒子的能量可能不会随时间变化，尽管它可能会随位置变化。如果是这种情况，Schrödinger 方程可以通过去除对时间 t t tt 的所有引用而大大简化。
Exception to this, for example, is when an electron makes a transition from one state to another. In this case one needs to consider the time dependent equation to obtain the transition rate.
例外情况是，当电子从一个状态跃迁到另一个状态时。在这种情况下，需要考虑时间依赖方程以获得跃迁率。

Reflection and Transmission coefficients
反射和透射系数

According to accepted convention, transmission and reflection coefficients are actually defined in terms of the ratios of probability fluxes.
根据公认的惯例，透射和反射系数实际上是根据概率通量的比率来定义的。
A probability flux is the probability per second that a particle will be found crossing some reference point traveling in a particular direction.
概率通量是指每秒钟在某个参考点被发现的粒子以特定方向穿过的概率。
Incident probability flux:
事件概率通量：
probability per second of finding a particle crossing a point at x < 0 x < 0 x < 0x<0 in the direction of increasing x x xx,
在 x x xx 方向上每秒找到穿过 x < 0 x < 0 x < 0x<0 点的粒子的概率，
Reflected probability flux:
反射概率通量：
probability per second of finding a particle crossing a point at x < 0 x < 0 x < 0\mathrm{x}<0
在 x < 0 x < 0 x < 0\mathrm{x}<0 处找到粒子穿过某一点的每秒概率
in the direction of decreasing x x xx.
朝着 x x xx 递减的方向。
Transmitted probability flux:
传输概率通量：
probability per second of finding a particle crossing a point at x > 0 x > 0 x > 0\mathrm{x}>0 in the direction of increasing x .
在 x > 0 x > 0 x > 0\mathrm{x}>0 处找到粒子沿着增加的 x 方向穿过一个点的每秒概率。
Since the probability per second that a particle will cross a given point is proportional to the distance it travels per second, the probability flux is proportional not only to the intensity of the appropriate wave but also to the appropriate velocity of the particle.
由于粒子每秒穿过给定点的概率与其每秒行进的距离成正比，因此概率通量不仅与相应波的强度成正比，还与粒子的相应速度成正比。

Important Points to note:
重要事项：

Classical Mechanics (CM) Quantum Mechanics (QM)
经典力学 (CM) 量子力学 (QM)
R = 0 R = 0 R=0\mathrm{R}=0
R > 0 R > 0 R > 0R>0

Quantum Mechanics:  量子力学：

The particle doesn’t vanish at the step; nor does the particle itelf split at the step.
粒子在这个步骤中并不会消失；粒子本身也不会在这个步骤中分裂。

In any particular trial the particle will go one way or the other.
在任何特定的试验中，粒子将朝一个方向或另一个方向移动。

For a large number of trials, the average probability of going in the direction of decreasing x x xx is measured by R R RR and the average probability of going in the direction of increasing x x xx is measured by T T TT.
对于大量试验，朝着减少 x x xx 方向的平均概率由 R R RR 测量，而朝着增加 x x xx 方向的平均概率由 T T TT 测量。

Lecture 3 Elementary Quantum Mechanics
讲座 3 基础量子力学

A particle initially in the region x < 0 x < 0 x < 0x<0, and moving towards x = 0 x = 0 x=0x=0 would, in classical mechanics, have probability one of passing the point x = 0 x = 0 x=0x=0 and entering the region x > 0 x > 0 x > 0\mathrm{x}>0.
一个最初位于区域 x < 0 x < 0 x < 0x<0 的粒子，如果朝向 x = 0 x = 0 x=0x=0 运动，在经典力学中，有百分之百的概率通过点 x = 0 x = 0 x=0x=0 并进入区域 x > 0 x > 0 x > 0\mathrm{x}>0 。
This is not true in quantum mechanics.
在量子力学中这并不成立。
Because of the wavelike properties of the particle, there is a certain probability that the particle will be reflected at the point x = 0 x = 0 x=0x=0, where there is a discontinuous change in the de Broglie wavelength.

Penetration of classically excluded region:
经典排除区域的穿透：
There is a finite probability of finding the particle in the region x > 0 x > 0 x > 0x>0
在区域 x > 0 x > 0 x > 0x>0 中找到粒子的概率是有限的
In classical mechanics it would be absolutely impossible to find the particle in the region x > 0 x > 0 x > 0x>0 because there the total energy is less than the potential energy.
在经典力学中，在区域 x > 0 x > 0 x > 0x>0 找到粒子是绝对不可能的，因为那里总能量小于势能。
Penetration does not mean that the particle is stored in the classically excluded region. Indeed, we have seen that the particle is definitely reflected from the step.
穿透并不意味着粒子被储存在经典排除区域。实际上，我们已经看到粒子确实是从台阶上反射的。
Penetration of the excluded region, which obeys eq.(11) is not in conflict with the experiments of classical mechanics.
排除区域的渗透，遵循方程(11)，与经典力学的实验并不冲突。
The probability of finding the particle x > 0 x > 0 x > 0x>0, is only appreciable in a region starting at x = 0 x = 0 x=0x=0 and extending in a penetration distance Δ x Δ x Delta x\Delta x, which equal 1 / k 2 1 / k 2 1//k_(2)1 / k_{2}.

The reason is that e − 2 k 2 x e − 2 k 2 x e^(-2k_(2)x)e^{-2 k_{2} x} goes very rapidly to zero when x x x\boldsymbol{x} is larger than 1 / k 2 1 / k 2 1//k_(2)\mathbf{1} / \mathbf{k}_{\mathbf{2}}.
原因是当 x x x\boldsymbol{x} 大于 1 / k 2 1 / k 2 1//k_(2)\mathbf{1} / \mathbf{k}_{\mathbf{2}} 时， e − 2 k 2 x e − 2 k 2 x e^(-2k_(2)x)e^{-2 k_{2} x} 会迅速趋近于零。
In the classical limit, the product of m m mm and ( V o − E ) V o − E (V_(o)-E)\left(V_{o}-E\right) is so large, compared to ℏ 2 ℏ 2 ℏ^(2)\hbar^{2}, that Δ x Δ x Delta x\Delta x is immeasurably small.
在经典极限下， m m mm 和 ( V o − E ) V o − E (V_(o)-E)\left(V_{o}-E\right) 的乘积与 ℏ 2 ℏ 2 ℏ^(2)\hbar^{2} 相比是如此之大，以至于 Δ x Δ x Delta x\Delta x 是不可测量的小。

Eq.(3-50) states that a particle of mass m m mm and total energy E E EE, incident on a potential barrier of height V o > E V o > E Vo > EV o>E, and finite thickness a a aa, actually has a certain probability T T TT, of penetrating the barrier and appearing on the other side

Energy-level diagram for the conduction electrons in two metals separated by a distance a a aa. The electrons move as essentially free particles within the metal. To induce a measurable electron tunneling current, a small voltage difference Δ V Δ V DeltaV\Delta \mathrm{V} is applied between the two metals. This offsets their energy levels as shown, so that electrons can flow from occupied states near E F E F E_(F)\mathrm{E}_{\mathrm{F}} on the more negative metal (on the left in the figure) to the unoccupied states just above E F E F E_(F)\mathrm{E}_{\mathrm{F}} on the more positive metal (on the right in the figure)
两个金属之间相距 a a aa 的导电电子能级图。电子在金属内基本上作为自由粒子移动。为了诱导可测量的电子隧穿电流，在两个金属之间施加一个小的电压差 Δ V Δ V DeltaV\Delta \mathrm{V} 。这使它们的能级如图所示发生偏移，从而使电子能够从更负金属（图左侧）附近的占据态 E F E F E_(F)\mathrm{E}_{\mathrm{F}} 流向更正金属（图右侧）刚好在 E F E F E_(F)\mathrm{E}_{\mathrm{F}} 之上的未占据态。

Lecture 3 Elementary Quantum Mechanics
讲座 3 基础量子力学

Examples on the applications of Quantum Tunneling
量子隧穿应用的例子

There are many semiconductor devices that operate based on quantum tunneling such as the tunnel diode and scanning tunneling microscope (see supplementary notes chapter 3)
有许多基于量子隧穿原理的半导体器件，例如隧道二极管和扫描隧道显微镜（见补充笔记第 3 章）

After studying this lecture 3, you should be able to answer the following questions:
在学习完这节课后，你应该能够回答以下问题：

  1. What does photoelectric effect experiment trying to prove?
    光电效应实验试图证明什么？
  2. Briefly discuss the Einstein’s quantum theory of the photoelectric effect.
    简要讨论爱因斯坦的光电效应量子理论。
  3. What is the meaning of the term “workfunction” in metal?
    金属中“功函数”一词的含义是什么？
  4. What is the equation of de Broglie relation?
    de Broglie 关系的方程是什么？
  5. What is the total energy of the particle?
    粒子的总能量是多少？
  6. Write down the wavefunction of a free particle in terms of its momentum and energy.
    写下自由粒子的波函数，表达为其动量和能量。
  7. Write down the time-independent and time-dependent Schrödinger’s equation in 1-D and 3-D.
    写下 1 维和 3 维的时间独立和时间依赖的薛定谔方程。
  8. What is a wavevector? (a) Express the wavevector in terms of momentum, (b) Express the wavevector in terms of energy.
    什么是波矢？(a) 用动量表示波矢，(b) 用能量表示波矢。
  9. What is a probability density?
    什么是概率密度？
  10. What are the boundary conditions for the wavefunction across a boundary?
    波函数在边界处的边界条件是什么？
  11. Define reflection coefficient R R RR and transmission coefficient T T TT. (i) What are values of R R RR and T T TT in for the two cases of step potential (a) E > V o E > V o E > VoE>V o and (b) E < V o E < V o E < VoE<V o. (ii) Discuss these two cases in terms of classical versus the quantum mechanical prediction.
    定义反射系数 R R RR 和透射系数 T T TT 。(i) 在阶跃势的两种情况下， R R RR 和 T T TT 的值分别是什么？(a) E > V o E > V o E > VoE>V o 和 (b) E < V o E < V o E < VoE<V o 。(ii) 从经典与量子力学预测的角度讨论这两种情况。
  12. What is the meaning of “penetration into the classically excluded region” or in terms of barrier potential, what is the meaning of “barrier penetration”?
    “穿透经典排除区域”的含义是什么？或者从势垒势能的角度来看，“势垒穿透”是什么意思？
  13. Briefly describe the principle behind the operation of STM.
    简要描述 STM 操作背后的原理。
